Container.Name: vector-syslog-adx
Container.Overview: Vector is a high-performance, ultra-lightweight log collector and forwarder. This template configures Vector to listen for UDP and TCP Syslog traffic on port 514 and stream structured JSON events to a free Azure Data Explorer (ADX) cluster using Microsoft Entra ID (Service Principal) authentication.
Container.Requires: REQUIRES PRE-CREATED AZURE RESOURCES: 1. An active Azure Data Explorer (ADX) cluster (or ADX Free cluster at aka.ms/kustofree) with a target database (e.g., MyADXDatabaseName) and table (e.g., Syslog). 2. An Azure Entra ID App Registration (Service Principal) with a Client Secret. 3. Database Ingestor permissions granted to the App Registration in Kusto (.add database DatabaseName ingestors ('aadapp=CLIENT_ID;TENANT_ID')). NOTE: The default vector.json configuration file is automatically downloaded from GitHub to your appdata folder on first container launch if missing.
Container.Changes: Updated default ADX Table Name to Syslog.
Container.PostArgs: -c 'mkdir -p /etc/vector && if [ ! -f /etc/vector/vector.json ]; then echo "Creating default vector.json..."; curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DataBitz/unraid-vector-syslog-adx/main/vector.json -o /etc/vector/vector.json; fi && exec vector --config /etc/vector/vector.json'

Config.Name: Vector Configuration File
Config.Description: Path to your local vector.json file on Unraid. Vector reads this file on startup to build the syslog ingestion pipeline.

Config.Name: ADX Cluster Name
Config.Description: The name of your free ADX cluster (e.g. 'MyADXClusterName' from ingest-MyADXClusterName.region.kusto.windows.net).

Config.Name: ADX Region
Config.Description: The Azure region where your ADX cluster is provisioned (e.g. 'eastus', 'westeurope', 'australiaeast').

Config.Name: ADX Database Name
Config.Description: The target Kusto database name created inside your ADX cluster.

Config.Name: ADX Table Name
Config.Description: The target table inside your Kusto database receiving structured logs.

Config.Name: Azure Tenant ID
Config.Description: Directory (tenant) ID from your Azure Entra ID App Registration.

Config.Name: Azure Client ID
Config.Description: Application (client) ID from your Azure Entra ID App Registration.

Config.Name: Azure Client Secret
Config.Description: Secret value generated under Certificates & Secrets for your App Registration.

Config.Name: Syslog UDP Port
Config.Description: UDP Port for receiving incoming Syslog packets from local network devices.

Config.Name: Syslog TCP Port
Config.Description: TCP Port for receiving incoming Syslog streams from local network devices.

Config.Name: Environment Tag
Config.Description: Custom metadata tag added to all outgoing logs to identify the origin network or host.

Config.Name: Syslog UDP Listener
Config.Description: Exposes UDP port 514 on the Unraid host interface for router/switch syslog traffic.

Config.Name: Syslog TCP Listener
Config.Description: Exposes TCP port 514 on the Unraid host interface for reliable syslog streaming.

Config.Name: Batch Max Bytes
Config.Description: Maximum payload size in bytes (default 1 MB = 1048576) accumulated before flushing to ADX.

Config.Name: Batch Timeout Seconds
Config.Description: Maximum elapsed seconds before pushing a batch to ADX, even if max bytes is not reached.

Config.Name: Disk Buffer Max Bytes
Config.Description: Maximum disk storage (in bytes) used to queue logs on Unraid during internet or ADX outages (default 5 GB = 5368709120).

Config.Name: Vector Log Level
Config.Description: Internal daemon logging level (info, debug, trace, warn, error).
